zh-CN.title: 焕新黑色电影背景
items: 典藏黑色电影背景新增缓慢流动的投影光束、胶片卷动和尘埃划痕
动态效果更加沉浸，同时保持聊天内容清晰并支持减少动态效果设置

en.title: Refreshed the Noir Film background
items: The collectible Noir Film background now features slow projector light, film movement, dust, and scratches
Motion feels more cinematic while keeping conversations readable and respecting reduced-motion settings
